verdict.rationale: Inngest is built specifically for durable, autonomous background execution: scheduled/cron functions, event-triggered functions, durable steps with automatic retries and checkpointing, wait-for-event/human-in-loop pausing, and dedicated durable-agent patterns (agent loops, sub-agent delegation) that resume execution exactly where they left off after failures or long waits. Community reviews corroborate reliable use for background job/video-processing pipelines running unattended for months.  Missing for 10: no independent third-party benchmark of a fully unsupervised long-running AI agent in production beyond vendor docs and general background-job testimonials.
